d:
Om jay lakshmi mata shubh dipavli! jay man lakshmi!
Dipavli ke pavan parv par man lakshmi aur bhagvan shri ganesh ki vidhi-vidhan se puja karne ke pashchat parivar sahit shraddha aur bhakti ke sath gaen man lakshmi ki mangal aarti – Om jay lakshmi mataprastut hai T-Series Bhakti Sagar ki or se man lakshmi ki yah pavan aarti.
